items.description: Operators wearing PPE and aware of emergency stop locations.
items.guidance: Confirm high-visibility clothing, hearing protection, and accessible stop buttons.

items.description: Field boundaries and exclusion zones marked and communicated.
items.guidance: Flag hazards and brief spotters before powering hydraulics.

items.description: Radio/voice comms check completed between cab and ground crew.
items.guidance: Perform a push-to-talk test and confirm hand signals.

items.description: Machine power, hydraulic pressure, and manual override tested.
items.guidance: Cycle actuators manually before enabling autonomy.

items.description: GNSS lock with acceptable HDOP and correction source verified.
items.guidance: Target HDOP < 1.5 with RTK/SSR corrections active.

items.description: Autosteer and section controllers respond to engage/disengage.
items.guidance: Use bench sequence before enabling live valves.

items.description: Failsafe watchdog heartbeat observed in Core and AGiO logs.
items.guidance: Check the safety log exporter if in doubt.

items.description: Simulation baseline replayed to confirm deterministic outputs.
items.guidance: Run `nexus sim smoke` or the QA dashboard warm-up.
Ensure log directory writable and retention matches policy.

items.description: Operator acknowledges checklist and assumes control when required.
Safety officer / QA lead authorises autonomous run.
items.guidance: Requires review of above sections before enabling autonomy.
